content.text: Many students of English like to watch movies as a way to improve their English.
content.trans: 英语：许多学习英语的学生喜欢看电影以提高他们的英语水平。

content.text: That's one of the best ways to learn English is through songs and movies.
content.trans: 英语：那是一本很好的学习英文的方法是通过歌曲和电影。

content.text: What do you think are some useful movies that people can watch to practice English?
content.trans: 英语：你认为有哪些电影可以帮助人们练习英语？

content.text: Well, I would recommend children's movies.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，我建议孩子们看儿童电影。

content.text: Really?
content.trans: 真的？

content.text: Yeah, they have simple vocabulary, but they have very common language.
content.trans: 是的，他们有简单的词汇，但他们的语言非常常见。

content.text: And also what's happening in the movie is very easy to understand and to follow.
content.trans: 而且电影中的事情也非常容易理解和跟随。

content.text: So you can see the action and then hear the word.
content.trans: 所以你可以看到动作，然后听到单词。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: So if you like to watch movies,
content.trans: 所以如果你喜欢看电影，那么你也可以尝试点和拍。

content.text: run to DVD or go buy a DVD,
content.trans: 英语：跑至DVD或去购买DVD。

content.text: watch it in the original language with English subtitles.
content.trans: 观看原声英文字幕。

content.text: So you should watch it in English with English subtitles.
content.trans: 所以你应该在英语和字幕中观看它。

content.text: Yeah, and what are subtitles?
content.trans: 是的，还有什么需要帮助的吗？

content.text: Subtitles are the words that you see at the bottom of the screen that translate.
content.trans: 字幕是屏幕底部看到的单词，翻译成中文就是“字幕”。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: What the people are saying.
content.trans: 英语：人们都在谈论。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: Yeah, that's the best thing to do.
content.trans: 是的，那正是最好的事情。

content.text: Try that exercise.
content.trans: 英语：试试那个练习。

content.text: If you have a pen and paper with you, it's much better.
content.trans: 如果你们有笔和纸，那会更好。

content.text: You can pause the movie right down the world you don't understand
content.trans: 你可以在全世界都不懂的情况下暂停电影。

content.text: and then maybe review it later.
content.trans: 和然后可能再看看它。

content.text: That's a really good tip.
content.trans: 这个是很好的建议。

content.text: I always tell my students that they should watch movies, listen to music,
content.trans: 我总是告诉我的学生他们应该看电影，听音乐。

content.text: read the newspaper, and write down at least five new words or phrases a week.
content.trans: 阅读报纸，并每周至少写下五新词或短语。

content.text: Yeah, yeah.
content.trans: 英语：是的，是的。

content.text: It's a really good exercise.
content.trans: 英语：它是一本好书。

content.text: And you'll improve a lot.
content.trans: 英语：And you'll improve a lot.

content.text: Yes.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: So everyone, we want you to go out and watch a movie in English.
content.trans: 所以，大家，我们希望你能在英语电影中观看。

content.text: Turn on the subtitles and write down some new vocabulary.
content.trans: 英语：打开字幕，写下一些新词汇。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: And if you have any comments or questions or maybe even suggestions,
content.trans: 如果您有任何评论或问题，或者甚至有建议，

content.text: you can come to our website at englishpod.com and leave them in our community page.
content.trans: 你可以通过我们的网站 [英语Pod. com] 和在社区页面留下他们。

content.text: And Marco and I are always around to help you.
content.trans: 和马克一起，我们总是愿意帮助你。

content.text: And we love to hear about what you're learning and what movies you're watching.
content.trans: 我们喜欢听到你正在学习什么，以及你在看哪些电影。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正好。

content.text: So we're out of time today.
content.trans: 今天我们时间有限。

content.text: We'll see you guys next time.
content.trans: 我们下次见。

content.text: Until then, it's...
content.trans: 直到那时，它就...

content.text: Goodbye!
content.trans: 再见！
